g.text: A20 | Fixed eligibility and gene-panel sensitivity
Points: paired medians. Lines: observed sample ranges. Panels have distinct gene sets and cannot be compared as quantities of function.
Day 42 only. A higher cell floor changes which samples qualify; it does not add biological replication.
